transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Thank you. Well, I came in because... recently the school district put this new bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on my plate, right on top of my regular teaching. 

I mean, I still get through the day, but I just feel wound up and discouraged in a way that isn't like me at all. I've even started putting off my lesson plans and work emails... things I used to handle without a second thought.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It's been about five months now. It started right around the time the district assigned me this rollout role midyear.
Outside of work, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

No, not really. I still enjoy the things I normally do. Um, I still like reading and spending time in my garden on the weekends, for example. It's really just the work stuff that's getting to me. When I'm actually doing my own hobbies, I still get the same enjoyment out of them.
Does this worry or tension spread to other areas of your life, or does it stay focused on work?

No, it really stays focused on work. Um, once I'm home and away from my school laptop, or just doing things around the house, I don't feel that same tension. It really is just tied to the school and dealing with that new rollout.
